findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (roll call 758, passed 66-47)
findings.note: She voted Aye on second reading of HB 958, an act making various changes to election laws. The ratified text requires a voter registration application to affirmatively state US citizenship before it is processed, adds a citizenship question at drivers licence office registration, and sets a process to remove voters flagged as potential non-citizens by a federal database. The ratified text has no photo-ID or in-person ID provisions.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, M11 Concur (roll call 801, passed 62-47)
findings.note: She voted Aye on the House motion to concur in the Senate changes to HB 958, the election law changes bill that includes a citizenship statement requirement on voter registration applications and removal of voters flagged as potential non-citizens.
NC House, Third Reading (roll call #810), 2024-12-11: yea (tally 73–45); census gate: none.
subjects: photo ID for all voters (constitutional amendment, in person and by mail)

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, second reading (roll call 758, 66 to 47)
findings.note: Rhyne is listed among the Ayes. The bill (fifth edition text at https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v5.pdf) changes the deadline for a voter without photo ID to bring ID after a provisional ballot, ties ID checks to mismatched ID numbers on registration, and adds citizenship-question rules for registration forms.
